notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only tower source is one row in the tnlandforms Georgia list, which gives county, coordinates and an unlabelled elevation column (read as feet, so 218.5 m in the record). The list's header says names for towers 73 and above are the compiler's own, so 'bowman' is a label, not evidence of a historical name. The tag 'datasheet' and the list's USGS/NGS sourcing are not explained on the page. Two web searches found no build, staffing, fire or fate history for this tower. Crawled checks found nothing: the NHLR Georgia list (29 lookouts) has no Bowman, the FFLOS Georgia cache has only Lafayette and Yonah, and the Eastern U.S. Lookouts Georgia list (69 entries) has no Bowman. The story is 143 words, above the 120-word floor.
